title: KYE Evidence Completeness Check
description: Verifies the canonical 15-item evidence checklist for a single decision: actor entity snapshot, principal entity snapshot, delegation ref, authority grant ref, scope ref, capability manifest ref, capability version/hash, credential binding ref, policy evaluation ref, decision result, reason code, audit event, payload hash/signature where applicable, state snapshot, timestamp.

decision_id.description: Admits either declared id class. Composed from the two CANONICAL grammar patterns (kye:decision and kye:pdc in internal) rather than a hand-merged third regex — a merged alternation is a new pattern nobody generated, and it drifts the moment either class's grammar changes (§0.49).

entity_class.description: §0.36 limb (c) self-declared artefact class — a term in kye:dictionary:entity-id-classes (membership enforced by admission-control; §0.49).
